curated-gf-chewy-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Chewy crowds its characters together with tucked-in terminals, say, for a barbershop sign. Noto Sans Thaana gives that heft some room, its wide channels and big open lowercase made for short stretches of reading.
curated-gf-chicle-gf-wellfleet: Commanding, that's Chicle, with letters clamped tight and a low x-height line. Wellfleet is the serif beneath it, a marker-nib stroke of constant weight that hums along as a flat gray texture over a longer passage.
curated-gf-chilanka-gf-kaisei-tokumin: Chilanka writes in a relaxed, hand-drawn line where horizontals weigh exactly what verticals do. Kaisei Tokumin is the serif opposite, all stout stems and slender hairlines, so the two feel like a loose sketch beside a crisp engraving.
curated-gf-chonburi-fs-azeret-mono: Heavy verticals, hairline diagonals, lots of space. Azeret Mono keeps its open-mouthed letters and wide spacing going steadily, so a longer stretch of this monospace feels measured and airy, though it is better for brief copy.
curated-gf-chonburi-gf-ubuntu-mono: Bold, spaced-out and sparkly with high contrast. Ubuntu Mono is the monospace counterpart, with tall small letters and sweeping curves that stay open, so it suits, say, an engineering blog, ideally at a modest size.
curated-gf-coda-gf-figtree: Coda opens its round letters wide and bold.  Figtree reads like marker-drawn stems and arcs, with a gap at the e's terminal, so a longer passage feels friendly and modern, say in a brand guidelines deck.
curated-gf-coiny-gf-datatype: Coiny spaces its tightly shut letters extra wide. Datatype, a monospace with typewriter-like widths and unshaded strokes, is the clear opposite: generous curve gaps against Coiny's gradual weight shifts.
curated-gf-combo-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma has lowercase packed up toward the caps and uncrowded mouths. Combo handles bold display, with big counters and gentle modulation, while the sans handles everything quieter beneath it.
curated-gf-comforter-gf-trocchi: Personal and relaxed, Comforter scrawls fat-stemmed letters that hug one another. Trocchi, a serif with a wide ring of a c and gently thinning bowls, carries a longer passage with quiet, dignified ease.
curated-gf-coming-soon-bitter: Coming Soon draws each stroke as stout as a pipe cleaner, handy for general purpose work. Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and see-through s, makes a longer passage feel grounded and dependable.
